title: Keep shooting — every photo saves the moment you snap it
body: The in-app camera now stays open after you take a picture: every tap of the shutter saves and uploads that photo right away in the background, with a counter showing how many you've saved. Take one photo or twenty without leaving the camera, then close it when you're done. Picking several photos from the strip or your album now works from every photo button in the app, not just the album pages.
